note: Draft second-round lore copy batch from the comprehensive italic read. Not approved.

patches.find: Want made them wiry, stubborn, and stubbornly hard to finish.
patches.replace: Want made them wiry, stubborn, and hard to finish.
patches.note: 'stubborn, and stubbornly' repeats the word inside one list.

patches.find: Its tomb has never been found. You have found its crown.
patches.replace: Their tomb has never been found. You have found their crown.
patches.note: The sovereign is 'they' in 1.3.7 and everywhere else; 'its' here reads as the crown's tomb.

patches.find: the Five Traditions survived the Fall; each scarred, perilous, and profoundly changed.
patches.replace: the Five Traditions survived the Fall, each scarred, perilous, and profoundly changed.
patches.note: A semicolon joins a fragment to the clause; a comma is the correct join.

patches.find: A priest capable of calling down a true working is a rarity; famous enough to command reverence and terrifying enough to be feared.
patches.replace: A priest capable of calling down a true working is a rarity, famous enough to command reverence and terrifying enough to be feared.
patches.note: Same fault: the semicolon introduces a fragment.

patches.find: Satyrs were fey once, before the long silence soured them,
patches.replace: Satyrs were fey once, before the Long Silence soured them,
patches.note: 1.3.1 names The Long Silence as one of the common folk's names for the Fall; the bestiary lowercases it.

patches.find: white court archers loose volleys of ice-fletched arrows,
patches.replace: White Court archers loose volleys of ice-fletched arrows,
patches.note: 'White Court' is the faction's proper name (capitalized in the Guard entry, the Boss, and Section 1); three Pale City entries lowercase it.

patches.find: the white court sentinel is the dead nobility's bodyguard,
patches.replace: the White Court sentinel is the dead nobility's bodyguard,

patches.find: *The white court executioner carries out sentences the living court passed centuries ago,
patches.replace: *The White Court executioner carries out sentences the living court passed centuries ago,

patches.find: tall dead men in iron helm and reach-halberd.
patches.replace: tall dead soldiers in iron helm and reach-halberd.
patches.note: Judgment call. The book otherwise keeps generic figures ungendered; 'a man's height' as a measure is idiom and left alone, but this names the soldiers themselves.
